review_redaction.purpose: Reviewer-facing derived copy (decision D-EXPORT-03), not the frozen file. Observed fields (outcomes of probes, smokes and pilots, token counts, real costs, real-run dates, corrections about earlier reports, paths under runs/) are removed; every settings field is unchanged.
review_redaction.removed: nothing: no observed field was found

scope: first-party smoke for GPT-5.6 Terra on item CB221, 16 calls. Pilot and full are not covered.

model.endpoint: OpenAI SDK default base URL (first-party API)

request_settings_on_the_wire.sdk_retries: max_retries=0 on the client; the runner makes one attempt per task

reasoning_effort_none.evidence: The model page lists reasoning_effort values none, low, medium (default), high, xhigh and max. Function-calling examples pass reasoning_effort 'none' with gpt-5.6-terra on Chat Completions.
reasoning_effort_none.to_confirm_in_smoke: the request is accepted and usage reports zero reasoning tokens

temperature_with_reasoning_none.evidence: The model guidance says temperature, top_p and top_logprobs must be removed when reasoning_effort is not 'none'; with 'none' they are supported.
temperature_with_reasoning_none.to_confirm_in_smoke: temperature 0 and 1 are both accepted alongside reasoning_effort 'none'

max_completion_tokens.evidence: An upper bound on generated tokens, visible output and reasoning tokens together. No minimum value is stated in what was read.
max_completion_tokens.to_confirm_in_smoke: a cap of 1 is accepted and can return a complete '0' or '1'; finish_reason under each cap is recorded

fields.prompt_tokens: all input tokens, cached and written included
fields.prompt_tokens_details.cache_write_tokens: cache writes; location inside the usage block to be confirmed in the smoke
fields.completion_tokens_details.reasoning_toke: reasoning tokens; optional in the reference, recorded as null and 'not reported' when absent

returned_model_string.evidence: Nothing read states whether the response reports 'gpt-5.6-terra' or a dated snapshot name. The contract expects 'gpt-5.6-terra' exactly; a different string stops the segment after the first call, which is recorded.

prompt_caching.evidence: Minimum cacheable prompt 1,024 tokens for GPT-5.6 and later. Writes are billed at 1.25x uncached input instead of the input charge; reads at 0.1x.

tariff.caveat: The launch post still shows $2.50 input and $15.00 output; the model page shows the rates after the 30 July price drop, used here. The extract was partly garbled: confirm on the pricing page before authorising a paid run. A changed rate needs a new snapshot id and a new route version.
tariff.code: python/src/chapter3/first_party.py, TARIFFS[snapshot_id]; the test suite checks the two agree

cost_estimate.formula: (prompt_tokens - cached_tokens - cache_write_tokens) x input + cached_tokens x cached_input + cache_write_tokens x cache_write + completion_tokens x output
cost_estimate.no_double_count: reasoning tokens are already inside completion_tokens and are not added again
cost_estimate.missing_cache_fields: taken as zero, so those tokens are priced at the ordinary input rate; an unreported write would be underpriced by a quarter of its input cost
cost_estimate.use: operational budget guard (--max-usd). Not the bill.
